name: Infection
desc: A wound has festered, becoming a far greater issue for you.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose 2 _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* During your _Travel Roll_, replace a _Stress_ stake with _Fatigue_ or add a _Stress_ stake, as appropriate.
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add losing a segment on this _Clock_ as an automatic _Stake_. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an additional _Infection_. This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Envenomed
desc: The after-effects of poison still lingering in your system, ravaging you from the inside and inflicting nausea and dizziness.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Gain 1 less Momentum at Respite.
* Take a -1 _Penalty_ on all rolls, including _Recovery_ rolls.
* During your _Travel Roll_, replace a _Stress_ stake with _Fatigue_ or add a _Stress_ stake, as appropriate.
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add losing a segment on this _Clock_as an automatic _Stake_. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an additional _Envenomed_. This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_. _Antidote_ and similar items can be used as _Medicine_ for this _Wound_.

name: Minor Burn
desc: A mild burn, caused by fire, acid, cold, or any variety of effects.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Increase your _Weakness_ to _Fire_, _Lightning_, and _Cold_ by 1 step.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity, add _Stress_ as a stake.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Burn
desc: A serious burn, caused by fire, acid, cold, or any variety of effects.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* You are _Weak_ to _Fire_, _Lightning_, and _Cold_.
* Whenever you take Damage, lose 1 _Guard_.
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add losing a segment on this _Clock_ as an automatic _Stake_. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an _Infection_. This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity, replace a _Stress_ stake with _Fatigue_ or add a _Stress_ stake, as appropriate.
* Add an additional _Stress_ stake when traveling in extreme heat or cold.
remove: When healed, replace this with a _Minor Burn_ and _Fatigue_.

name: Major Burn
desc: A severe, life-threatening burn, caused by fire, acid, cold, or any variety of effects.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Increase your _Weakness_ to _Fire_, _Lightning_, and _Cold_ by 2 steps.
* Whenever you take Damage, lose 2 _Guard_.
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add losing a segment on this _Clock_ as an automatic _Stake_ twice. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an _Infection_.  This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity, add a _Fatigue_ stake.
* Add an additional _Stress_ and _Fatigue_ stake when traveling in extreme heat or cold.
remove: When healed, replace this with a _Moderate Burn_ and _Fatigue_.

name: Minor Flesh Wound
desc: A deep cut or stab that, while not life threatening, makes normal function far more difficult.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* The first time you take Damage each Round you gain _Bleeding_ [6].
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity in a _Skill Challenge_ add _Stress_ as a stake.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Flesh Wound
desc: A deep cut or stab that poses a high risk of dangerous infection.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* The first time you take Damage each Round you gain _Bleeding_ 1.
* Attacks against you gain [_Piercing_].
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add losing a segment on this _Clock_ as an automatic _Stake_. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an _Infection_. This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity add a _Fatigue_ stake.
remove: When healed, replace this with a _Minor Flesh Wound_ and _Fatigue_.

name: Major Flesh Wound
desc: A deep cut or stab that barely missed vital organs and make it difficult to move.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* The first time you take Damage each Round you gain _Bleeding_ 2.
* Attacks against you gain [_Piercing_].
* Gain 1 less _Momentum_ and _Posture_ at _Respite_.
* Whenever you make a _Rest Roll_ add add losing a segment on this _Clock_ as an automatic _Stake_ twice. If the Clock is empty, instead gain an _Infection_. This stake may be removed with _Medicine_, but _Medicine_ used as a part of the _Patch_ _Camp Action_ does not count for this.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity add a _Blood Loss_ stake.
remove: When healed, replace this with a _Moderate Flesh Wound_ and _Fatigue_.

name: Minor Concussion
desc: A minor head wound that makes it difficult to focus and remain fully lucid.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose 3 _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* You may not play the Observation Augment.
* Whenever a Career would grant information, roll a d6; on a 2-, you cannot remember anything except vague details. Any resources spent to gain this information are still lost.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Blood Loss
desc: You've lost a great deal of blood, leaving you weak and light-headed.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Your maximum _Stamina_ is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1.
* Lose 1 _Momentum_ at _Respite_.
* In _Skill Challenges_ (including _Travel Rolls_) replace a _Stress_ stake with _Fatigue_ or add a _Stress_ stake, as appropriate.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_. You may automatically mark a segment by consuming an extra _Meal_ during the _Camp Phase_.

name: Hypoxia
desc: The side effects of being deprived of oxygen for too long.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose 2 _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* Lose 1 _Momentum_ at _Respite_.
* Your counter for _Suffocating_ starts one higher than it normally would.
* In _Skill Challenges_ (including _Travel Rolls_) replace a _Stress_ stake with _Fatigue_ or add a _Stress_ stake, as appropriate.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Concussion
desc: A head wound that makes it very difficult to focus and remain fully lucid.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose 3 _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* You always have the _Dazed_ Status.
* You may not play the Observation Augment.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous mental activity, add _Stress_ as a stake.
* Whenever a Career would grant information, roll a d6; on a 4-, you cannot remember anything except vague details. Any resources spent to gain this information are still lost.
remove: When healed, replace this with a _Minor Concussion_ and _Fatigue_.

name: Minor Leg Injury
desc: A minor leg injury that hampers mobility to a small degree, like a rolled ankle.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
*Gain 1 less _Speed_ at _Respite_.
* Roll one less die whenever your ability to use your legs is important, such as _Travel Rolls_.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Leg Injury
desc: A leg injury that hampers mobility significantly, typically inflicted from a powerful attack.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Decrease the _Speed_ gained at _Respite_ by 1.
* You are always _Slowed_, and may not clear it by any means.
* Add an extra _Fatigue_ stake in _Travel Rolls_.
* Roll one less die whenever your ability to use your legs is important, such as _Travel Rolls_.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_ and a _Minor Leg Injury_.

name: Major Leg Injury
desc: One of your legs is grievously injured and barely usable, leaving you limping and immobile.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Decrease the _Speed_ gained at _Respite_ by 2.
* You are always _Slowed_, and may not clear it by any means.
* You may not gain _Speed_ after _Respite_.
* Add an extra _Fatigue_ stake in _Travel Rolls_.
* You may not purchase the _Phase_ _Advantage_ except with die granted to you by other characters.
* Roll two less die whenever your ability to use your legs is important, such as _Travel Rolls_.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_ and a _Moderate Leg Injury_.

name: Minor Arm Injury
desc: A minor arm injury that hampers its use to a small degree, like a sprained wrist.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Decrease the Momentum gained at Respite by 1.
* Roll one less die whenever your ability to use your arm is important, and take 1 Stress if you do any Camp or Travel Actions that requires both your arms.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Arm Injury
desc: A moderate arm injury that makes it difficult to use an arm without completely limiting its use.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Decrease the Momentum gained at Respite by 2.
* You are always _Impaired_, and cannot clear it by any means.
* Roll one less die whenever your ability to use your arm is important, and you cannot take any _Camp_ or _Travel Actions_ that require both your arms.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_ and a _Minor Arm Injury_.

name: Major Arm Injury
desc: A major arm injury that makes an arm all but unusable.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Decrease the Momentum gained at Respite by 3.
* You cannot use one arm in any way.
* You are always _Impaired_, and cannot clear it by any means.
* Gain an automatic _Stress_ each morning.
* Roll two less die whenever your ability to use your arm is important, and you cannot take any _Camp_ or _Travel Actions_ that require both your arms.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_ and a _Moderate Arm Injury_.

name: Minor Contusion
desc: A heavy impact that doesn't break the skin, but leaves minor internal damage.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose an additional _Guard_ whenever you take Damage.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity, add _Stress_ as a stake.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_.

name: Moderate Contusion
desc: A heavy impact that doesn't break the skin, but leaves internal damage that makes normal function difficult.
effect:
While you have this Wound:
* Lose an additional 2 _Guard_ whenever you take Damage.
* Whenever undertaking strenuous physical activity, add _Fatigue_ as a stake.
* Automatically gain _Stress_ at the start of each day.
remove: When healed, replace this with _Fatigue_ and a _Minor Contusion_.

name: Stress
desc: The stress and strain of adventuring is taking a toll, impacting your mental state.
effect: This has no effect on its own.
remove: Many _Camp Actions_ and items mark a segment on this Clock.

name: Extreme Stress
desc: You are irritable, unfocused, and unable to work as a team.
effect:
This is inflicted when _Stress_ is replaced. While you have this Condition:
* You may not aid allies in _Skill Challenges_ and may not aid them.
* You may not forge _Bonds_.
* Gain 1 less _Momentum_ at _Respite_.
* Any progress towards clearing _Stress_ is instead placed on this Condition.

name: Fatigue
desc: You are tired, whether from travel, the throes of battle, or just overexerting yourself.
effect:
While you have this Condition:
* Lose one _Guard_ at _Respite_.
remove: You may mark a segment on this _Clock_ with _Efficacy_ during a _Rest Roll_.

name: Exhausted
desc: You are beyond tired from pushing yourself too hard and struggle to stay awake.
effect:
This is inflicted when _Fatigue_ is replaced. While you have this Condition:
* Lose 2 _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* Any progress towards clearing _Fatigue_ is instead placed on this Condition.

name: Hungry
desc: Your stomach is empty and a constant distraction.
effect:
While you have this Condition:
* Lose one _Guard_ at _Respite_.
remove: Consuming an extra _Meal_ during the _Camp Phase_ marks a segment on this Clock.

name: Starving
desc: You are at the brink of starvation and struggling to stay alive.
effect:
Gain this Condition when _Hungry_ is replaced on your _Health Bar_. While you have this Condition:
* Lose two _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* Any progress towards clearing _Hungry_ is instead placed on this Condition.

name: Thirsty
desc: Your mouth is parched, making everything a bit more difficult.
effect:
While you have this Condition:
* Lose one _Guard_ at _Respite_.
remove: Consuming an extra portion of water during the _Camp Phase_ marks a segment on this Clock.

name: Dehydrated
desc: You haven't had water long enough that its substantially impacting your health.
effect:
This Condition is inflicted when _Thirsty_ is replaced. While you have this Condition:
* Lose two _Guard_ at _Respite_.
* Any progress towards clearing _Thirsty_ is instead placed on this Condition.

name: Flying
desc: You are propelled by craft or wing, allowing you to easily soar through the arena.
effect:
While Flying:
* You ignore all non-_Weather_ _Terrain_ effects.\n* While not _Engaged_ with _Terrain_ or a non-Flying creature, non-Flying creatures may not become _Engaged_ with you.
* Increase the Cost to _Negate_ _Prone_ and _Forced Movement_ by 2 and, if you are knocked _Prone_, you immediately _Fall_ 2.

If a creature _Engages_ Terrain, they also lose Flying. If a creature loses Flying naturally (either by choice or their effect granting Flying ending), they may safely land and suffer no ill effects.

name: Entangled
desc: A creature that is entangled in some sort of material, whether that be vines, spider silk, or wires.
effect:
Entangled is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. The effect of Entangled depends on the current die value compared to your size:
* Less Than: You are _Hobbled_.
* Equal To: Also, you have _Disadvantage_ on _Attack_ and _Defense Rolls_.
* Greater Than: You are _Immobilized_ instead of _Hobbled_.
repeat: Increment the die. If you cannot, gain 3 _Stun_.
remove: Decrement your Entangled die if you take 4+ _Slash_ damage. A creature may choose to target just the Entangling effect when attacking.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 4+, decrement the Entangled die.

name: Suffocating
desc: A creature that is unable to breathe and rapidly losing consciousness.
effect:
Suffocating is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. Increment the counter when:
* You take a Turn.
* You lose half or more of your Stamina from a single effect.
* You make a non-Light Attack.
* You spend 2 or more _Speed_ in a single Turn.

If you would ever increment the die while already at 6, gain the _Hypoxia_ _Wound_ then reset the die to 1. Note that _Hypoxia_ reduces the maximum value of this counter.
remove: Typically, Suffocating can only be removed by effects that specifically remove it. If removed, the counter resets the next time the creature is Suffocating.

name: Alight
desc: An condition caused when you are on fire.
effect:
Alight is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. At the start of your _Turn_ take _Piercing_ _Fire_ _Damage_ equal to the die (_Stun_ if _Resistant_), then increment the die. While Alight:
* Gain _Resistance_ (_Cold_). You may not become _Frozen_.
* At 3+, you're a _Minor Source_ (_Fire_) and _Ignite_ your _Engagement_ at the start of your _Turn_.
* At 5+, increase the Damage by 2.
repeat: Increment the die. If you cannot, take 2 _Fire_ Damage.
recover: Decrement the die, then make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 5+, decrement again. If you are _Prone_, decrement again.
reacts: <ins>_Water_:</ins> If hit with _Water_, decrease the value by 1.
<ins>_Soaked_:</ins> If you would gain _Soaked_, remove all _Alight_ but do not gain _Soaked_.

name: Frozen
desc: An condition caused when you are covered by thick ice.
effect: While a creature has Frozen they take _Stab_ _Damage_ equal to its value at the end of any _Turn_ that they spend _Speed_. Additionally, the creature can be treated as a _Minor_ _Source_ (_Ice_). Finally, they increase their [_Fire_] Resistance by 1 step.
repeat: Frozen stacks, and if a creature gains Frozen again combine the values.
recover: When a creature _Recovers_ they may reduce _Frozen_ by 4. Additionally, whenever a creature takes _Fire_ Damage they reduce their Frozen by 2, and by 1 when they take _Crush_ Damage.
special: Creatures with _Resistance_ (_Cold_) reduces any afflicted Frozen by their number of _Resistance_ steps, and automatically clears the same amount of Frozen at _Respite_. Finally, when a creature inflicts _Shatter_ on a Frozen creature, they can choose to clear any amount of Frozen, inflict additional Damage equal to twice the Frozen removed.

name: Bleeding
desc: You are actively bleeding and rapidly losing your ability to fight.
effect:
Bleeding is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. While you are Bleeding lose _Stamina_ equal to the die value at the start of your _Turn_. If you would ever increment the die while already at 6, gain the _Blood Loss_ _Wound_ then reset the die to 1. If you end combat Bleeding you must spend _Supplies_ or gain a _Blood Loss_ _Wound_. If you would be _Downed_ by Bleeding, suffer the below effects:
* **6-12**: Gain a _Blood Loss_ _Wound_.
* **3-5**: Gain two _Blood Loss_ _Wounds_.
* **2-**: Gain three _Blood Loss_ _Wounds_.
recover: Create an _Opening_ and spend a _Wielded_ _Supplies_, then make a _Recovery Roll_. Reduce your _Bleeding_ die by the result.
remove: Only effects that specifically remove Bleeding remove it.

name: Soaked
desc: You are drenched in water.
effect:
While Soaked:
* Increase you _Resistance_ to _Fire_ by one step.
* You may not gain _Alight_. If you would gain _Alight_, remove Soaked.
*Gain a _Weakness_ to _Cold_ and _Lightning_; if you take _Cold_ Damage, remove _Soaked_ and gain _Frozen_.
remove: Only effects that specifically remove Soaked remove it.

name: Enraged
desc: You are filled with a blinding, dangerous fury.
effect: Enraged is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. While Enraged, gain +X to all _Attack Rolls_, -X to all _Defense Rolls_, and take an additional X _Stun_ from all Attacks, where X is half the die rank.
repeat: Increment the die. If you cannot, take 3 _Stun_.
reacts: <ins>_Calm_:</ins> If a creature is _Calm_ and would gain Enraged, they instead decrement their Enraged.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 4+, decrement Enraged. If you're _Engaged_ with the target of your rage, roll with _Disadvantage_.

name: Joyful
desc: You are filled with an energizing, contagious sense of joy.
effect: Joyful is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. While Joyful, at the end of each of your _Turns_ you and all allies you are _Engaged_ with gain _Guard_ equal to half the die value.
repeat: Increment the die. If you cannot, gain 2 _Guard_.
reacts: <ins>_Anguished_:</ins> If a creature is _Anguished_ and would gain Joyful, they instead decrement their _Anguished_.

name: Disarm
desc: An effect where an item is wrenched away from a creature.
effect: An item the Target has _Worn_ or _Wielded_ (chosen when this Status is inflicted by the Attacker) is immediately dropped unattended in the current _Arena_. If the Attacker has the appropriate _Free Hands_, they must choose to instead immediately _Wield_ the item.

name: Taunted
desc: You are single-mindedly focused on a foe.
effect: While Taunted all Attacks that do not target the taunter are made at _Disadvantage_, and creatures must spend an additional Speed when leaving an _Engagement_ or _Arena_ that includes the taunter. Additionally, when an NPC or Spirit is Taunted, they ignore their normal targeting for Attacks and instead prioritize the taunter; if they cannot Attack the taunter they may use their normal targeting, but should prioritize targets that bring them closer to the taunter.
repeat: If a Taunted creature would gain Taunted , lose 1 _Guard_ and treat the second creature as the taunter.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 4+, remove Taunted. If you're _Engaged_ with the taunter, roll with _Disadvantage_.

name: Engaged
desc: A status showing when things are in close proximity.
effect:
While Engaged with 
* a creature, spending _Speed_ creates an _Opening_ and you have _Disadvantage_ on all Attacks that do not Target at least one creature you are Engaged with.
* _Terrain_ gain the listed effects of said Terrain.
remove: Characters may spend 1 _Speed_ to remove all instances of Engaged (see _Speed_).

name: Exposed
desc: An condition caused when an opening in a creature's defenses has been forced open.
effect: Attack against an Exposed creature have _Advantage_.
repeat: If an Exposed creature would gain Exposed they instead lose 2 _Guard_.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 3+, remove Exposed.

name: Grabbed
desc: A status caused when creatures are locked in close combat and clinging to one another.
effect:
When Grabbed is inflicted, instead inflict _Grappled_ if the Attacker is the same size or larger than the Target, or Riding if the Attacker is smaller than the Target.

Alternatively, when you inflict Grabbed you can try to end a grab the target is involved in; a creature Grappled/Ridden by them may immediately attempt to escape (see Recover) with _Advantage_.

name: Grappled
desc: A status caused when creatures are locked in close combat and clinging to one another.
effect:
* You may not react to the Grappler's _Openings_.
* You may not inflict Grabbed on the Grappler.
* You are _Immobilized_. You move with the Grappler and, if you would be _Forcibly Moved_, they may _Negate_ for you, splitting the _Guard_ cost between the two of you evenly.
* If you are within 1 of the Grappler's Size, they are _Hobbled_.
repeat: Inflict your choice of 4 _Stun_, _Impaired_, _Exposed_, or _Vulnerable_. While the Grapple persists, this may not be cleared by any means.
recover: You and the Grappler make a _Recovery Roll_; if you roll higher, end the effect. The Grappler may pay 1 _Momentum_ or 3 _Guard_ to reroll their die.
remove: If you lose _Engagement_ with the Grappler by any means, end the effect. The Grappler may end this effect at any point on their Turn.

name: Ridden
desc: A status caused when creatures are locked in close combat and clinging to one another.
effect:
* You may not react to the Rider's _Openings_.
* You may not inflict Grabbed on the Rider.
* The Rider moves with you, including _Forced Movement_.
 * If the total Size of creatures Riding you is within one Size of you, you are _Hobbled_, or _Immobilized_ if it is greater.
repeat: Inflict your choice of 3 _Stun_, _Impaired_, or _Exposed_. While the Ride persists, this may not be cleared by any means.
recover: You and the Rider make a _Recovery Roll_; if you roll higher, end the effect. The Grappler may pay 1 _Momentum_ or 3 _Guard_ to reroll their die.
remove: If you lose _Engagement_ with the Rider by any means, end the effect. The Rider may end this effect at any point on their Turn.

name: Hobbled
desc: An condition caused when a creature's speed is impaired somehow.
effect: While Hobbled all Speed costs are increased by 1.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 4+, remove Hobbled.

name: Impaled
desc: You have something embedded in you, causing a great deal of pain.
effect: Some effects may Impale a creature, leaving an object inside of them. While Impaled, a creature has _Vulnerable_ equal to the _Load_ of the item (minimum 1). In addition, while an item is Impaled it counts as a _Worn_ item by the creature but may be targeted as if it was _Unattended_. Any Attacks using an Impaled item against that creature have _Advantage_, ignore _Block_, and cannot be _Defended_ against.
repeat: A creature may be Impaled by multiple effects.
recover: When a creature _Recovers_ they may remove Impaled, but take damage equal to the twice the _Load_ of the item.

name: Impaired
desc: An condition caused when a creature's ability to attack is limited.
effect: Attacks by an Impaired creature have _Disadvantage_.
repeat: If an Impaired creature would gain Impaired they instead lose 2 _Guard_.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 3+, remove Impaired.

name: Immobilized
desc: Your speed is restricted to the degree that you may not move.
effect: While Immobilized a creature may not spend _Speed_ except to remove a _Status Effect_ causing this status.

name: Poisoned
desc: An condition caused by toxins ravaging you from the inside out.
effect: Poisoned is tracked with a d6, which starts at 1. At the start of your _Turn_ take _Unblockable_ _Poison_ _Damage_ equal to the die (_Stun_ if _Resistant_). At 3+, gain _Disadvantage_ on _Recovery_ _Rolls_. At 5+, gain _Disadvantage_ on all rolls. At the end of your _Turn_, make a _Recovery Roll_ (at _Advantage_ if you have _Resistance_); on a 5+, decrease your Poisoned value by 1. If you would ever increment the die while already at 6, gain the _Envenomed_ _Wound_ then reset the die to 1.
remove: Poisoned is only removed by effects that explicitly remove it.

name: Prone
desc: An effect caused when a foe is knocked flat on their back.
effect: A Prone creature is _Immobilized_. While Prone, Melee attacks against the target gain Advantage, but Range 1+ attacks have Disadvantage.
remove: A creature may expend one _Speed_ to end Prone.
recover: When a creature _Recovers_ they may expend one Speed to remove _Prone_ without creating an _Opening_.

name: Pull
desc: You drag a foe closer to you, or simply pull them into a nearby obstacle.
effect:
Pull lists two Negate costs. If the Target does not pay the higher of the _Negate_ costs, choose one:
* If they are _Engaged_ with another creature, immediately inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on both.
* If they are _Engaging_ Terrain they could slam into, inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on them and create a _Collision_.
* Force the target to stop _Engaging_ their current _Terrain_ and leave their current _Engagement_. You may then force them to enter a new _Engagement_ of your choice within their current _Arena_, so long as it brings them closer to you.

 If the target did not _Negate_, you may instead move them to an adjacent _Arena_, so long as this moves them to an _Arena_ closer to you.

name: Push
desc: You launch a creature away from you, creating space and sending them away.
effect:
Push lists two Negate costs. If the Target does not pay the higher of the _Negate_ costs, choose one:
* If they are _Engaged_ with another creature, immediately inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on both.
* If they are _Engaging_ Terrain they could slam into, inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on them and create a _Collision_.
* Force the target to stop _Engaging_ their current _Terrain_ and leave their current _Engagement_. You may then force them to enter a new _Engagement_ of your choice within their current _Arena_, so long as it does not make them _Engaged_ with you.

 If the target did not _Negate_, you may instead move them to an adjacent _Arena_, so long as this moves them to an _Arena_ further from you.

name: Slide
desc: You adroitly move a foe about, placing them where you wish.
effect:
Slide lists two Negate costs. If the Target does not pay the higher of the _Negate_ costs, choose one:
* If they are _Engaged_ with another creature, immediately inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on both.
* If they are _Engaging_ Terrain they could slam into, inflict 2 _Crush_ Damage on them and create a _Collision_.
* Force the target to stop _Engaging_ their current _Terrain_ and leave their current _Engagement_. You may then force them to enter a new _Engagement_ of your choice within their current _Arena_.

 If the target did not _Negate_, you may instead move them to an adjacent _Arena_.

name: Studied
desc: An condition caused when one creature gains knowledge on another.
effect:
Creatures may remove a hostile creature's _Studied_ for one of the following effects:
* Clear _Studied_ at any time to learn the target's current and maximum _Stamina_ and _Block_, their _Defenses_, and any _Weaknesses_/_Resistances_/_Immunities_ they have.
* When making an Attack or Defend Roll in response to the Target, you may clear Studied to increase the result of a single die roll by 1.
recover: Make a _Recovery Roll_; on a 4+, remove Studied.

name: Shatter
effect: When a creature gains Shatter a piece of _Worn_ or _Wielded_ _Equipment_ or a _Breakable_ _Trait_ loses 1 _Durability_, chosen by the Attacker. If a creature has no remaining _Equipment_ with _Durability_ they instead gain _Exposed_ and lose 2 _Guard_.

name: Concentrating
desc: A creature that has a singular focus, granting them an enhanced ability to act.
